summary.recommended_next_step: Do not proceed with the rename. If the terminology change is still desired, a constitutional amendment process is required: (1) establish semantic equivalence of proposed terms against canonical sources, (2) draft a single coordinated change that updates CLAUDE.md, all seven canonical v1 documents, README_LAYER2.md with new filename, all governance workflows, agent definitions, skill instructions, and code paths simultaneously, (3) route the full amendment through doc-code-sync-check and deep audit before applying. No partial application is permitted.
